en.help.mesh.remove_islands: Remove loose pieces below a minimum triangle count. The largest connected piece is always kept.
en.help.mesh.move_vertex: Move the vertex nearest the picked point by X, Y and Z in the mesh's local axes.
en.help.mesh.split_edge: Pick near a triangle edge to split every incident triangle at its shared midpoint.
en.help.mesh.subdivide_face: Divide a picked triangle into three triangles meeting at its center.
en.help.mesh.delete_face: Remove the picked triangle and leave an opening in the mesh.
en.help.mesh.cleanup: Weld coincident vertices and remove duplicate triangles, degenerate triangles and unused vertices.
en.help.mesh.smooth: Smooth an imported scan while holding its boundary in place.
en.help.mesh.decimate: Reduce the triangle count of a scan to a target percentage.
en.help.mesh.flip_edge: Pick the shared edge of two adjacent triangles to replace it with the opposite diagonal.
en.help.mesh.fill_holes: Close simple boundary loops up to the maximum number of edges.
en.help.mesh.orient_normals: Make neighboring triangles face consistently and turn closed shells outward.
en.help.mesh.delete_island: Pick a face to remove its connected island from the mesh.
en.help.mesh.inspect_topology: Count triangles, boundary edges, nonmanifold edges, winding conflicts, and degenerate triangles.
en.help.mesh.delete_region: Remove connected triangles within the normal angle of the picked region.
en.help.mesh.isolate_region: Keep the picked region and remove the remaining triangles from this mesh body.
en.help.mesh.trim_plane: Clip triangles against an offset world plane and keep the selected side.
en.help.mesh.section: Intersect an offset world plane with the mesh and create an editable sketch.
en.help.mesh.align_scans: Refine the alignment of a roughly positioned moving scan against a fixed reference scan.
en.help.mesh.compare_scans: Sample the unsigned distance from a measured scan to a reference scan and display deviations relative to a tolerance.
